summary: All fields are well-supported by PSI-25.search.json, PSI-25.csv, BASS overview PDF, and challenge brief. Only conditions.airflow has a conflict: PSI approach and SIBAL paper support 1-40 cm/s, but BASS-II overview PDF and challenge brief state 5-50 cm/s. Extracted record's 1-40 cm/s at medium confidence is a reasonable synthesis but noted as partly supported.
